outcome: Experiment browsing shows the exact current-revision timestamp and actor provenance
owner_impact: Each owned, shared or supervised Experiment in the library now identifies its current saved revision with exact local date/time including seconds and timezone plus the actor that produced that revision. Existing Claude and Grok OAuth client identifiers render as readable names; human revisions render as Human; unknown AI clients remain explicit instead of being hidden.

next.text: The bounded #392 UI pass is complete and #273 returns dormant. No Experiment storage or revision model changed. The displayed provenance applies to the currently stored revision; superseded revision history is not reconstructed by this ticket.

technical_evidence: Experiment rows already carried revision, updated_at, updated_by_actor and updated_by_ai_client; #392 only exposes those existing fields.
The revision timestamp is rendered with date, hour, minute, second and timezone in the browser's local timezone.
Known historical/current Claude and Grok OAuth client IDs map to readable labels with an explicit fallback for unknown AI-client identifiers.
Owned, shared, supervised and direct Experiment reads retain current-revision provenance fields.
No database schema, trigger, revision semantics, connector or development-workflow rule changed.
